summary: Rewrote the value-policy-learning family page and hand-wrote six approach pages for the research console: chance-state-nnue, conservative-fitted-policy-iteration, d4-q-clone, denoised-value, direct-policy, and dqn. Each page follows the four-altitude approach-page template, quotes only numbers that exist in a retained record with their source and evidence label (ledger-recorded vs task-record only), states 'no retained result' where that is the truth, and carries the audit-03/audit-04 caveats about scoring mode and unrecoverable rejections. No research record, protocol, or source file was modified and no experiment was run.
